meta_description: Turquoise glazed ceramic rectangular mosaic tiles for bathroom walls, showers and vanity splashbacks. See them in Lahore or Islamabad or ask for a sample.
description:
These turquoise mosaic tiles for bathroom walls are small rectangular pieces of glazed ceramic, made for shower walls, vanity splashbacks and accent panels.

## How they look
The rectangular shape gives a brick-like rhythm, similar to a mini subway layout, in a bright turquoise glaze. Glazed ceramic catches the light, so the colour shifts slightly from piece to piece and the wall looks lively rather than flat.

## Where they work
- **Shower walls**, where the glaze makes splashes easy to wipe away.
- **Behind the basin or vanity**, as a coloured splashback against white sanitaryware.
- **A single feature wall**, paired with plain white or grey tiles on the other walls so the turquoise does not overwhelm a small washroom.

Glazed ceramic is a practical surface for wet areas in Pakistani homes because it is generally simple to clean and does not stain as easily as unglazed clay.

## Good to know
Rectangular mosaic can be set horizontally for a wider look or vertically to make a low ceiling feel taller. White grout keeps it fresh; grey grout hides marks better in a busy family bathroom.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to check the shade against your fittings, then get a dated quote. More options are in the [bathroom wall mosaic range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-mosaic).

faqs.q: What is the price of turquoise mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) and you get a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can I use these tiles inside a shower?
faqs.a: Yes, glazed ceramic mosaic is commonly used on shower walls. Use a waterproof adhesive and seal the grout once it has cured so moisture stays out of the joints.

faqs.q: Mosaic or subway tiles for a bathroom wall?
faqs.a: Rectangular mosaic gives a similar brick pattern to subway tiles but in smaller pieces, so it adds more texture and bends better around niches and corners. Larger subway tiles mean fewer grout lines to clean.

faqs.q: How can I see the colour before buying?
faqs.a: Ask for a free sample on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) or visit the Lahore or Islamabad showroom and compare it with your fittings.
